queries.prompt: cell-based architecture는 shard나 multi-region이랑 뭐가 다르고, shared dependency가 남으면 blast radius가 왜 줄지 않아?
queries.reformulated_query: cell based architecture versus shard multi region shared dependency blast radius failure domain
queries.rationale: shard hotspot보다 cell architecture의 failure domain과 shared dependency 구분이 primary다.
